never: invent an edition, a jurisdiction or a date
accept a change to the rules
issue, imply or foreclose a certificate
resolve a source conflict between two live instruments
stays_with_person: accepting a change to an instrument, and deciding what it does to existing cards
resolving a source conflict between two live instruments
every certificate, sign-off, statement of compliance and anything that carries a licence number
any answer where the consequence of being wrong is somebody's safety
deciding a question is outside the rules held, and saying so to the person who asked

provider_block.job: staff answer from the rules, with the source attached

with_us.note: No hosted step. The production check runs over the source cards and change feed the office owns.

checks.title: Every production answer carries a source card
Cards name an edition, a jurisdiction and an effective date
Superseded clauses cannot produce a live answer
Instrument changes are accepted before production
Public and internal answers run different policies
Answers are stored with their cards
Nothing issues, implies or forecloses a certificate
